description: Remove a teammate from this workspace immediately so they can no longer access this brand. Ask the user first.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

changeSecretLinks.description: Defaults to true: the live calendar feed and every client review link get a new address, because every member could read them. false leaves them as they are, and the answer names what was left. Webhooks the person added are switched off either way.

everywhere.description: true removes the person from every brand of this owner they are in, not only this one. Owner only.

userId.description: Teammate userId from team_members_list to remove from this workspace.

name: team_member_remove
title: Remove a team member
